transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess my eating has just been kind of... all over the place lately. It kind of scared me into coming in, honestly. Like, some days I'll just forget meals completely. And then... I don't know, other nights I'm up past midnight just tearing through takeout and whatever snacks I have. So... yeah. That's mostly it.
Have you lost any weight recently?

Um... I don't really know. I don't weigh myself much. Like I was just saying, my appetite is just everywhere right now. So I guess it probably just fluctuates with all the skipped meals and then the late-night takeout. But... yeah, I haven't really checked a scale.
Do you ever worry about gaining weight?
Um... not really, no. I mean, I guess it's not something I really think about much.
Do you think about your body shape or appearance when you're deciding what or how much to eat?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't know, it doesn't really cross my mind. I just eat whatever's around, I guess.
Do you notice that you eat more or less when you're feeling stressed or upset?
I don't know. I guess I don't really pay attention to that. I just... eat when I eat.
Do you think your mood affects how you eat?

Um... maybe. I guess my eating has just been... kind of all over the place lately. It's actually sort of what scared me into coming in. Like... some days I just completely forget meals. And then other nights, I'm up after midnight just tearing through takeout and whatever snacks I have. So... yeah, maybe it does.
Do you usually eat when you're feeling emotional?

I mean... like I just said, I don't really know if it's about being emotional. My eating is just... all over the place. That's really what scared me into coming in. Just... forgetting meals completely some days, and then other nights tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight. I don't really track how I'm feeling when it happens.
Do you often find yourself not really feeling like eating?

Yeah... like I was just saying. Some days I completely forget to eat. I guess I just don't have an appetite then. It's just been all over the place... which, again, is really what scared me into making this appointment.
Do you think you're just not interested in food on the days you forget to eat?

I don't know... I guess so. Like I keep telling you, I just completely forget to eat. I'm not really analyzing if I'm interested or not. It's just... my eating is totally off. That's the whole reason I made this appointment in the first place. Nothing some days, and then eating everything in the house in the middle of the night on others. I just... I don't know why.
Do you think your eating changes when you're feeling anxious or upset?
I really couldn't say. I... I haven't noticed if I'm anxious or upset when it happens. Like I said, I just... I don't really track how I'm feeling. It just happens.
Do you feel hungry on the days you forget to eat?

I don't think so... I mean, if I was hungry, I'd probably eat. But like I keep saying, it's just... it's all over the place. That's why I'm here. One day I'm not eating, and then... other nights I'm just tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight. It's just weird.
Do you think you're not eating on some days because you're just not hungry?

I mean... I guess? Like I just said, I don't really know if it's about being hungry or not. It's just... honestly, it's the main thing that scared me into actually coming in here. Just how all over the place it is. Going from completely forgetting meals to... tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight. I don't really have a better way to explain it to you.
Do you think your eating is triggered by your emotional state?

I really couldn't tell you. I... I feel like you just asked me that. I don't really sit around analyzing my emotions all day. Like I said, I just know my eating is all over the place right now. That's all I really know.
Do you think your emotions play a role in your decision to eat or not eat on any given day?
I... I really don't know. Like I said, I'm not... I don't really track how I'm feeling when I eat. I just know it's not normal for me.
Do you think you're not eating on some days because you're just not interested in food?
I... I don't know. Maybe. I just... I don't really think about it. I just don't eat sometimes.
Do you think you're not eating on some days because you're just not interested in food?
I mean... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said, maybe. I just... I don't really care about food sometimes. That's it.
Is it that you're not interested in food on the days you don't eat, or is it that you just don't think about eating?

I guess... I don't really know the difference. I just don't think about it, and I don't want it. I'm not really analyzing it that much... I just don't eat. I don't really have a better answer for you.
Do you think your eating more at night is related to how you're feeling at that time?

I don't know if it's about how I feel... it's just that my eating has been all over the place. Like I said, some days I just forget to eat completely. But then... other nights, I'm just tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight. It's actually kind of what scared me into coming in here.
Is your lack of eating on some days due to not being interested in food?
I... look, we just went over this. I don't know why you keep asking it the same way. I just don't eat sometimes. That's all I can tell you.
Is your eating pattern more related to a lack of interest in food or to something else?
I really don't know what else to tell you. I don't have a reason for it. I'm just... not eating sometimes. That's it.
